# Vipattivāra (Pvr 1.3)

**ID:** Pvr 1.3
**Section:** Parivāra (pvr)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Vipattivāra
**Title (English, SuttaCentral):** The classes of failure to which each rule belongs

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vipattivāra* is the third section of the first chapter of the *Parivāra*, the closing treatise of the Theravāda Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Functioning as an analytical catechism on monastic discipline, the text systematically classifies the Vinaya rules in relation to the four traditional classes of "falling away" or failure (*vipatti*) from proper monastic conduct [SuttaCentral]. An English translation by Bhikkhu Brahmali is hosted on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral notes no curated external parallels in other canonical languages [SuttaCentral]. According to DharmaNexus text-reuse analysis, the text exhibits dense internal reuse within the Pali canon, sharing 122 matching passages across 21 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest share of textual correspondence occurs with other analytical recensions in the *Parivāra*, most notably the *Antarapeyyāla* (Pvr 4), various iterations of the *Samuccayavāra* (Pvr 1.8, 1.16, 2.16) and *Vipattivāra* (Pvr 1.11, 2.3, 2.11), as well as the *Adhikaraṇabheda* (Pvr 11), *Saṅgahitavāra* (Pvr 1.4, 1.12), *Samuṭṭhānavāra* (Pvr 1.5, 1.13), *Adhikaraṇavāra* (Pvr 1.6), and *Samathavāra* (Pvr 1.7) [DharmaNexus]. Textual material is also shared with the commentary on the *Parivāra* (*Parivāra-aṭṭhakathā*) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meet the threshold score in DharmaNexus [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
